passives.name: Project: Conqueror
passives.description: (Passive Effect) At the start of battle, grants an irremovable reduced damage taken to the caster for [Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single] turn(s). When attacking, if granted a dispellable buff, Inferior Core attacks all enemies and reduces Health by [Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000063_2_2] each. Reduces Effectiveness of non-Defender enemies by 80%. (Triggered Effect) Upon taking a critical hit, has a [Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000063_4_2] chance to counterattack, and recovers Weakness Gauge by [Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000063_4_3].
